summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K with six Next Day Disclosure Returns detailing ongoing share repurchases on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange between June 22–26, 2026. The filings report multiple daily repurchases at weighted average prices ranging from approximately HKD 42.57 to HKD 45.01 per share and USD 5.30 to USD 5.76 per ADS, with no shares cancelled yet shown as treasury. The company acts as the issuer returning capital to shareholders. No board recommendation or advisor is cited. The mechanics reflect a continuing buyback program, raising the question of whether the pace will accelerate. Watch for potential completion announcements or suspension.
